name: spherePrimary_ofReal

name: spherePrimary_ofReal_im

name: spherePrimary_ofReal_nonneg

name: re_mul_of_im_eq_zero

name: ASection.supLevel_mem_closure

name: liKernel
statement: K(n,a,β;z) = 1 − ((z−a)/(z−(2β−a)))^n : ℂ — the anchor-pair Möbius kernel, mirror-symmetric about Re = β; all parameters real and bound.
note: D0 kernel of the B2.2 BL ladder (DESIGN_B2_2_kernels.md); pure ℂ, base-agnostic; consumed by liSum and all D1–D3 rows.

name: ASection.liSum
statement: liSum A a β n := ∑' k, 2·Re(liKernel n a β (A.sphereZero k)) : ℝ — the conjugate-paired kernel sum read over the enumerated divisor.
note: D0 sum; reads the zero divisor (OBJ-zero adjacent); totality genuine — kernel pole real, every sphereZero has im > 0.

name: liRatio
statement: liRatio a β z := (z − a)/(z − (2β − a)) : ℂ — the anchor-pair Möbius ratio; liKernel = 1 − liRatio^n definitionally.
note: Unit circle of the ratio = the mirror line Re = β; the modulus trichotomy engine.

name: liKernel_eq_ratio
statement: liKernel n a β z = 1 − liRatio a β z ^ n (rfl).
note: Definitional unfolding row connecting kernel to ratio; used throughout.

name: liRatio_num_ne_zero
statement: z.im ≠ 0 → z − (a : ℂ) ≠ 0 for real a — the ratio numerator is nonzero off the real axis.
note: Junk-value hygiene: no division by zero, totality genuine.

name: liRatio_den_ne_zero
statement: z.im ≠ 0 → z − (2β − a : ℂ) ≠ 0 — the mirror anchor is real, so the denominator is nonzero off ℝ.
note: Junk-value hygiene twin of the numerator row.

name: liRatio_ne_zero
statement: z.im ≠ 0 → liRatio a β z ≠ 0.
note: Combines num/den nonvanishing; feeds the direction-normalization in the D1/D2 engines.

name: normSq_anchor_sub_mirror
statement: ‖z − a‖² − ‖z − (2β − a)‖² = 4(β − a)(Re z − β) — the key identity: squared-distance difference to the anchor pair reads the side of the mirror line.
note: Mission D1's key identity; drives the modulus trichotomy (=1 on the line, <1 near side, >1 wrong side).

name: liRatio_norm_eq_one
statement: z.im ≠ 0, Re z = β → ‖liRatio a β z‖ = 1 — on the mirror line the ratio is unimodular.
note: The (⟸) engine of finite_BL: unimodular ratio gives 2(1 − cos nθ) ≥ 0 termwise.

name: liRatio_norm_lt_one
statement: z.im ≠ 0, (β − a)(Re z − β) < 0 → ‖liRatio a β z‖ < 1 — near side of the mirror gives sub-unimodular ratio.
note: The D3 case; consumed by liSum_first_side and liSum_second_side.

name: one_lt_liRatio_norm
statement: z.im ≠ 0, 0 < (β − a)(Re z − β) → 1 < ‖liRatio a β z‖ — wrong side of the mirror gives super-unimodular ratio.
note: The contrapositive's engine; side classification is a-independent per the key identity.

name: liKernel_re_nonneg
statement: z.im ≠ 0, Re z = β → 0 ≤ Re(liKernel n a β z) — mirror-line termwise positivity, the 2(1 − cos nθ) ≥ 0 form.
note: Termwise half of finite_BL's (⟸) direction.

name: exists_pow_forall_norm_sub_one_lt
statement: Finitely many unit ω ∈ Finset ℂ return jointly near 1: ∀ ε > 0, N, ∃ n ≥ max(N,1), ∀ ω ∈ t, ‖ω^n − 1‖ < ε.
note: The simultaneous return (Dirichlet/pigeonhole in metric form via compact torus); R5 record: no simultaneous Dirichlet lemma in Mathlib pin.

name: exists_liKernel_sum_neg
statement: Multiset S off ℝ with one element z₀ strictly wrong-sided ((β−a)(Re z₀−β) > 0) → ∃ n ≥ 1 with the mapped kernel sum over S negative.
note: D1 contrapositive engine: at a simultaneous return, wrong-sided r^n outgrows 2·card S.

name: finite_BL
statement: Finite-multiset Bombieri–Lagarias: for S ⊂ ℂ off ℝ, two-sided kernel-sum positivity (all a < β and a > β, all n ≥ 1) ⟺ ∀ z ∈ S, Re z = β.
note: D1, ladder L2; fidelity note: im ≠ 0 strengthens the BL source's two-point avoidance (author rider 1, 2026-07-04).

name: summable_inv_one_add_norm_sq_center_shift
statement: Summable 1/(1+‖ρk − c‖²) at one real center c → summable at every real center c′ (explicit comparison constant 2 + 2(c′−c)²).
note: C-1 step (3): center-shift stability of quadratic point-density; makes the density goal center-free.

statement: For ‖w‖ ≤ D, 1 ≤ D: ‖(1+w)^n − 1 − n·w‖ ≤ ‖w‖²(1+D)^n — the paired binomial tail bound, quadratic remainder after j = 0,1.
note: C-1 step (4): isolates the one Re-needing j = 1 term; quadratic remainder absorbed by the point-density.

name: ASection.blDensity_of_density
statement: Quadratic density at one center → Σk (1+|Re ρk|)/(1+‖ρk − c‖²) < ∞ at every real center c (the strip bounds the numerator).
note: Sekatskii (ii) in-frame — exactly Theorem 2's convergence condition (READ_weil_li_findings.md); consumes the strip rows.

name: ASection.liSum_summable_of_density
statement: Quadratic density of the divisor at the mirror anchor 2β − a → Summable (2·Re K(n,a,β; sphereZero k)) — C-1's summability from density.
note: C-1 steps (3)+(4) assembled: strip bounds the j = 1 term, binomial tail majorized outright.

name: ASection.liSum_summable_of_density_at
statement: Quadratic density at ONE real center c₀ → summability of the kernel terms for every anchor pair (a,β) and every n.
note: Single-center C-1 reduction = center-shift + the paired binomial comparison; consumed by liSum_summable at c₀ = 0.

statement: For every A : ASection, a β n: Summable (fun k => 2·Re(liKernel n a β (A.sphereZero k))) — D0 closed from c3_atN.
note: D0 CLOSED (2026-07-06): C3's own convergence clause through N discharges it; lifts the burn-order fence for D3/D2.

statement: ∃ β (namely Ω₀ + 1), ∀ a < β, ∀ n ≥ 1: 0 ≤ A.liSum a β n — one-sided kernel positivity above the upper edge.

name: norm_one_add_pow_sub_one_sub_mul_le'
statement: Small-deviation binomial tail: for 0 < D, ‖w‖ ≤ D: ‖(1+w)^n − 1 − n·w‖ ≤ (‖w‖²/D²)(1+D)^n — base 1+D arbitrarily close to 1.

name: exists_liKernel_sum_neg_slack

note: D2 limit passage, negativity form (private): head/tail split of the GENUINE convergent sum at a density threshold; junk-tsum hygiene honored.

name: Octonion.alt_right

name: Octonion.innerO_def'

name: Octonion.innerO_mul_mul_right

name: Octonion.normSq_smul
statement: normSq (r smul x) = r^2 * normSq x — quadratic homogeneity.
